paite: Pathian aw, vai hon hawmsak inla, Pathian limsak lou nam tung ah ka thu hon genpih in; aw, mikhem hat, midiklou lak ah hon humbit in.
heading: Saltangmi Thumna / (Sam 42)
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

paite: Nang ka hatna Pathian na hi ngal a; bang ding in ahia na hon pampaih ding? Bang ding in ahia melma nuaisiahna ziak a lungkham a ka mau vialvial nak?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

paite: Aw, na vak leh na thutak sawlkhia inla, amaute'n na mual siangthou ah hon pi in, na omnate hon tun uhen.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

paite: Pathian maitam kiang ah ka pai ding, Pathian ka nopna mahmah kiang ah; Pathian, ka Pathian aw, kaihging toh in ka hon phat ding hi.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

paite: Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amah phat ding ka hi ngal a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
